description: In make it for me (the guide's default), once the look is settled and you've written the script and picked the rest yourself: shows the person the whole brief on one card, in tabs (where their chat shows cards): for a motion film the script line by line, the three motion ideas you invented (yours first), the look and its details, the voice with its sample, the sound and the format; for a story its scenes (each voice line with what its picture shows), the characters, the art style, the voice, the sound and the format. Every look and art style, their saved voices and your voice search sit on it to pick from, with one Make it button and a Change on every part. Pass everything you decided: what you leave empty isn't shown. Say the estimate as one range in your message right above it; the card never shows it. Then wait: "Make it." (or "Make it with idea 2: …" from an older card: build that one), sent, is their OK for this video's paid steps (the voice, pictures, music and export) within that range. Spends nothing and starts nothing. Call it again after a change.

ambience.description: A sound bed under the voice ("waves and wind"), or "None"

captions.description: The captions: for a motion film in a few words ("on, word by word"); for a story its caption style (Calm lines, Word pop, Bold box) or "None"

characters.description: A story's characters who come back in more than one picture

looks.description: How they look in every picture

who.description: Who they are in a few words: "the keeper, about 70"

colours.description: The colours' name, or #RRGGBB, when not the look's own; empty for its own

ending.description: How it ends on screen: "the last line, then a 1 s hold"

estimate.description: The whole video's estimate exactly as you say it in your message, e.g. "about 5,000–7,500 credits". Never shown on the card

first_line.description: The script's first line, word for word

ideas.description: For a motion film: three motion ideas for the whole film (the guide's MOTION, INVENTED EVERY TIME), each a different world, the one you'd make first. Empty for a story or a film copying a reference

chain.description: What the hero becomes, line by line, in a few words each

hero.description: The hero, chosen from this topic: "the line you type"

why.description: Why this one, in a line

length.description: How long, as you'd say it: "about 45 s"

lettering.description: A motion look's lettering in a few words: "hand-lettered, rounded"

look.description: The look's id: a motion look id, a story look id (story:<id> or the id), or one of their own (my-…, or an own_look id)

look_name.description: The look's name as they see it

mood.description: A story's mood in a few words: "quiet and lonely, warm at the end"

music.description: The music in a few plain words: "A loop: warm piano, slow", "Composed for this video, builds to the reveal", "None"

on_screen_text.description: Titles or key words shown apart from the captions, or "None"

scenes.description: A story's scenes from your storyboard, in order. Empty for a motion film

line.description: What the voice says in this scene, word for word

picture.description: What its picture shows, in a plain sentence

script.description: A motion film's whole script, word for word, one sentence or short line per item, in order. Empty for a story (its scenes carry the lines)

shape.description: The frame: "Vertical 9:16", "Square 1:1" (motion films only) or "Wide 16:9" (for YouTube). The one you then make it in: format in start_video or start_story

sound_effects.description: The sound effects in a few words, or "None"

texture.description: The look's texture in a few words

title.description: The title, as the cover headline reads

voice_id.description: The voice you picked, from voices; empty only for a story told with captions and no voice

voice_name.description: That voice's name, as the voices tool lists it

voice_pace.description: How fast the voice reads: "relaxed, small pauses"

voice_search.description: The words you searched the voice library with, so the card lists those voices to pick from

voice_tone.description: How the voice reads: "deadpan, dry, no overacting"

name: brief
title: Show the brief
